metadata.description: Ten practical Claude Code mods: cost, proof-of-done, handoff, deletions bin, recording, model router, secret sentry, peer reflect, session map, notifications.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: Warns near context limits and builds a /handoff snippet for a fresh session.

plugins.name: deletions-bin
plugins.description: Intercepts destructive rm/unlink Bash and rewrites to move into .claude/deletions-bin.

plugins.name: done-notify
plugins.description: Toasts when a long turn finishes; /notify-test fires a sample toast.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Routes Agent tool calls: simple chores to Haiku, heavy work stays on Sonnet/Opus.

plugins.name: peer-reflect
plugins.description: After each turn, posts a short peer-review checklist above the prompt.

plugins.name: proof-of-done
plugins.description: Requires real test/verification evidence before /claim-done is allowed.

plugins.name: recording-mode
plugins.description: Toggle /recording to mask emails and secret-looking tokens in the AbovePrompt banner.

plugins.name: secret-sentry
plugins.description: Blocks Write/Edit tool calls that contain API keys, PEM blocks, or .env secrets.

plugins.name: session-map
plugins.description: Live map of files Claude Read this session; /files lists them.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Live token/cost band above the prompt, with /warm-cache keep-alive counter.
